title: Basement O' Rats — caves
style: 16-bit SNES (Chrono Trigger), dark underground · tiles-only migration
note: Tilesets for the 4 cave scenes that were still single-PNG backgrounds (tavern-basement already has a tileset). rat-tunnel = dirt + blue fungus; underground-choices = grey stone; momentary-detour = glowing pool; rat-den = filthy floor + rat-hole walls. Plus cave props the scene intros call for.
